scope: Existing wrap candidate, proposed cover-fixed keeper, and alternative straight-pull ball at polar90. No production CAD edited; no candidate mesh/continuous collision validation claimed.

existing_wrap.meaning: Ideal taut flexible core is pulled against the inner rail. Ball-to-rail and rail-to-port tangent lengths are fixed for fixed radius, so the incremental payout is Rc*dtheta, not R60*dtheta. Actual cable bending, friction, seating and printed groove dimensions are unmeasured.
existing_wrap.stop_budget_action: Include the 0.116667 mm nominal shortfall. Existing16..22 equivalent stop adjustment contains ideal20.117351, but set actual endpoint with the feed carriage20mm stop and then trigger stop; do not use wire stretch or blindly adopt20.117351.
existing_wrap.radius65_scope: Previously sourced supplier minimumR65 applies to flexible housing, not an established bare-core wrapping radius.

fixed_keeper_review.full_top_open_cut_risk: Opening the same exit cut throughZ7.5 removes outer wall at global angles69.9014..96.9014 at20mm nominal. A remote skirt only prevents complete outward escape; a loose core can leaveR60 intoR61.1..64 and be trapped when the uncut rotating wall returns.
fixed_keeper_review.recursive_local_relief: A fixed inner keeper over global68..90 requires rotor clearance over local68..111 for21deg travel; the relief then sweeps back toglobal47..90. Adding a keeper for the new unguarded47..68 continues the recursion. The earlier limited radial-relief suggestion was withdrawn as an unproved complete solution.
minimal_constraints: Protect the full permitted angular interval, including adjustable-stop extreme or explicitly constrain that setting.
The core must not enter a clearance that later closes under a rotating outer wall or rotating bottom edge. A skirt preventing loss of the cable is not necessarily a track-retention proof.
Ball insertion/removal remains with cover removed along local+Z. An installed ball must be retained against both axial lift and escape through the cable throat.
For cover removal along+Z, any fixed wire outlet guide must be open continuously to the keeper bottom; a closed transverse hole can trap the cable during cover withdrawal.
Check full source-derived core segments, ball envelope and fixed/rotating solids. Do not test only the animation centreline.
larger_alternatives: Remove the whole moving upper outer rim and construct a continuous stationary guide, with independent bottom-edge and ball-retention proof; local skirt patches are insufficient.

A separately printed rotating keeper bolted to the wheel avoids fixed/moving sweep recursion, but needs real fastener seats, retention and accessible tool paths. No such CAD is accepted by this review.

direct_pull_polar90.sweep_design_implication: Replace the old R60 slot and old ball position with a true moving-frame segment sweep open to+Z. Full-stroke core reaches radial57.10, crosses the oldR58.9 inner wall and105deg spoke. Do not assume the existing tangent cut clears it.
direct_pull_polar90.ball_capture_candidate: At polar90 the fixed-to-rotor wire fan spans about15.385deg. A2.2mm core slot has an approximate2.95mm mouth span at radius2.8 around the ball, below nominal ballD5. This is a preliminary throat estimate, not a rigid sphere escape/cap clearance proof.
direct_pull_polar90.geometric_advantage: Core no longer needs to remain on a prescribed R60 circular contact rail, removing the wrapping-keeper recursion; the straight segment still needs complete clearance and proper ball retention.

M6_exit_gap.reason: The full-pull line extended through24mm drifts1.66444mm, beyond the1.5mm total diameter clearance even if both ends float to opposite sides. Real core must change direction/contact near or within the metal exit.
unclosed: Actual exit-edge radius and core contact position are not dimensioned.
Bare-core permitted bending radius, contact friction and fatigue are unconfirmed.
Bending/contact changes free length; fixed-Q ideal20mm is not yet a real cable-payout contract.
possible_next_steps: Use a defined guide or articulated outlet whose real contact path can be included in length and interference calculations.
Alternatively retain the wrap scheme and solve manufacturability by a bolted split rotating keeper with real fasteners.

direct_pull_polar90.qualified_conclusion: Promising bounded kinematic alternative. Ideal20mm is exact only for an inextensible straight free segment with fixed exitQ; no current claim of real20mm payout or full manufacturability.
